about: Derivation record for the archival PDFs in this folder. Every page is one photograph, cropped to the quadrilateral in `crop_quad` (clockwise from top left, in the photograph's own pixels after EXIF orientation), perspective-corrected onto a rectangle, then tone-mapped. Editing `crop_quad` and re-running `render` and `pdf` reproduces the page with a different crop; nothing else is needed.

collection.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Département de la Musique

pipeline.leaf_detector: macOS Vision VNDetectDocumentSegmentationRequest (vision_corners.py), refined by ruling-based squaring
